On Buddy dark dog REMOVE EVERY curled/engraved mark from dark neck below face, shoulders, chest dark fields, torso, rump and legs. Replace with smooth close-clipped charcoal tonal wash, clean silhouette. Keep natural localized pale beard/moustache, brows and ear furniture. No coat enlargement, no change to anatomy, no added hair or marks. Do not sharpen texture. Very smooth low-detail body surfaces are essential. Input1 edit target; input2/3 eligible originals. Ball retains fuzzy tennis texture. Entire rest of picture preserved. No text.

Absolutely zero tiny marks, texture, hatching, curls, engraved lines, swirls, brush hair or pattern anywhere on Neet tan forehead, neck, trunk or legs, nor on Buddy dark torso. Think smooth cut-paper silhouettes filled with flat watercolor gradients. Preserve dog anatomy, pose, facial emotion, positions, four feet each, collars and lead attachments. Buddy cream muzzle/beard, pale eyebrows and ears alone retain strands. Neet tan torso must look like clean plain matte paper colored with one broad wash, devoid of ANY repeated marks. Input3 N19 and input4 B04 original photo likeness authority. Preserve input1 STREET SCENE: night, flashlight beam and human shoe at left, giant chartreuse tennis ball on pavement left foreground, Neet small tan dog unable to bite it, Buddy at right amused. Both standing four supported legs, Neet fine legs with full narrow torso and tiny nub, Buddy elongated body/substantial legs. No proportion changes. Clear soft shadows give volume without texture.
